attchmntText: Reliance Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Reliance Infrastructure Limited has received applications from Reliance Innoventures Private Limited and its subsidiary, Reliance Project Ventures and Management Private Limited, to reclassify their status from promoter group to public. This request follows the implementation of the Resolution Plan for Reliance Innoventures Private Limited by Sagacious Capital Private Limited under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The Board of Directors reviewed these applications on November 13, 2026, and determined that they comply with Regulation 31A of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The Board has decided to proceed with the necessary steps in accordance with applicable laws. The company has submitted this disclosure to the stock exchanges for their records.

attchmntText: Reliance Infrastructure Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Reliance Infrastructure Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The Board has placed before members for approval the renewal of authorization to issue Foreign Currency Convertible Bonds up to U.S.$ 600 Million. The statutory auditors issued a disclaimer of conclusion on the financial results. The auditors were unable to assess the recoverability of Economic Rights in Odisha Discoms and unlisted entities valued at Rs. 4,705.74 Crore. They also could not determine implications of ongoing proceedings by the Enforcement Directorate, Central Bureau of Investigations, SEBI, and SFIO. Additionally, the auditor of subsidiary Mumbai Metro One Private Limited modified its review conclusion due to material uncertainty regarding the entity's ability to continue as a going concern. Mumbai Metro One Private Limited reported a loss of Rs. 701.21 crore for the period and has negative net worth. The auditors stated that material uncertainties exist that may cast significant doubt on the Group's ability to continue as a going concern.
